lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region. The columns show roughly uniform horizontal spacing with increasing vertical density towards the dorsal carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a rectilinear grid-like appearance where blobs are positioned at the intersections of these luminance bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity pixels (shadow) on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-luminance linear mark (possible scar) is visible on the lower flank, oriented diagonally just above the insertion point of the pectoral fin.
